notes.title: Update Information V3.05
notes.notes:
TyranoBuilder has been updated.
The current version is V3.05.

[h1]Update Details[/h1]

・Bug fixes
・Updated built-in TyranoScript version
・Added new theme “Kaguya (KAGUYA)”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/e9c2bb6082d9f9d0ebfda88151973debec20111e.png[/img]

[h1] We have moved TyranoBuilder v3.0 from Beta to the Main Branch![/h1]

【Important】
This update introduces significant changes.
Projects created with previous versions (V2.x) will attempt to convert and run on V3.x, but we cannot guarantee full compatibility with all projects.

Please make sure to back up your project before updating.

If your previous projects do not function properly in V3.0, we kindly ask you to continue using the older version.

You can select previous versions from the Library by going to Properties → Betas tab.


[h1]TyranoStudio Now Available on Steam[/h1]

TyranoStudio, the development tool for TyranoScript, is now available on Steam.

If you want to implement more advanced effects or processing in TyranoBuilder,
you can achieve even more sophisticated games by utilizing TyranoScript.

■Tyrano Studio URL
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634660/TyranoStudio_Visual_Novel_Scripting/]Tyrano Studio Steam site [/url]

[h1]Differences from TyranoBuilder[/h1]

TyranoBuilder is a GUI‑driven tool that relies on drag‑and‑drop—anyone can create a game simply by combining ready‑made components. The trade‑off for this ease of use is a slight reduction in development freedom.

Tyrano Studio, on the other hand, lets creators build games by writing its own text‑based scripting language. Because you work directly in script, it offers far greater creative freedom and is better suited to full‑scale, professional game development.


thanks.

notes.title: [Major Update] Beta Release of Version 3.00 Now Available
notes.notes:
Thank you for using TyranoBuilder.
We’re excited to announce a major update to the software.

[b]【Important】[/b]
This update introduces significant changes, and as such, it will initially be released as a beta version.
Projects created with previous versions (V2.x) will attempt to convert and run on V3.x, but we cannot guarantee full compatibility with all projects.

Please make sure to back up your project before updating.

If your previous projects do not function properly in V3.0, we kindly ask you to continue using the older version.

[h2]How to Use TyranoBuilder 3.0[/h2]

Until the official release, this update must be applied manually.
In your Steam Library, right-click on "TyranoBuilder Visual Novel Studio," then go to the gear icon → Properties → Betas, and select "v3,00beta".

After that, restart TyranoBuilder to use the latest version.

If the new version does not work correctly, you can revert to a previous version from this same menu.

[h2]Update Highlights[/h2]

Here are the major new features included in this update:

[h2]Upgraded to the Latest TyranoScript V6 Series[/h2]
TyranoBuilder now uses TyranoScript V6, replacing the older V5 version.

This brings a significant increase in available features, improved middleware performance, faster execution, and greater stability.

Previously, some of the newest TyranoScript tags were not available in TyranoBuilder — that’s now resolved.

[h2]Six New System UI Themes[/h2]
We've added several new "Themes" that allow you to completely change the system UI of your game with just a few clicks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/ef19b0488bae12ec9961d62203276dcf9f784b15.jpg[/img]

[h2]Message SFX (Popopo Sound) Feature[/h2]

You can now play retro-style "popopo" sound effects in sync with message text.

■ Demo: https://tyrano.jp/demogame/popopo/

You can assign different sounds to each character or freely change the sound at any point.

It’s easy to set up — just drag and drop the "Popopo Sound" component from the "Message" category into your timeline.

[h2]Auto Layout and Customization for Choice Buttons[/h2]
Previously, choice buttons had to be positioned manually.
Now, they can be automatically arranged without setting coordinates each time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/0cb08b055134d3e7882d9936ab41f248f858b951.png[/img]

[h2]Gamepad and Keyboard Support[/h2]

You can now play your games using only a gamepad or keyboard.

For example, players can use arrow keys to navigate choice buttons and press Enter to select — no mouse required.

This setting can be enabled under Game Config → "Keyboard & Mouse" → "Controls" tab.

[h2]Localization (Translation) Features[/h2]

If you're developing for an international audience, TyranoBuilder now offers robust translation tools:

Auto-detection and extraction of translatable text

Language switching in a single build

Auto-detection of player’s system language

Exporting translatable content to CSV (for editing in Excel or other tools)

You can seamlessly convert between multiple languages, such as:

[list]
[*] Japanese → English
[*] Japanese → Chinese
[*] English → Japanese
[*] English → Chinese
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/13f8187a19ddfc6ac89fbdd486fd0dbac37224e8.png[/img]

[h2]Zoom & Focus on Speaking Characters[/h2]

A new feature highlights the currently speaking character by zooming in or applying focus effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/7fe439ff185d5e9e978bb07b45f6441bb9b0da54.gif[/img]

[h2]Enhanced Cursor Customization[/h2]

You now have full control over the cursor:

Change the cursor at any point in the game

Adjust cursor hitboxes for precise interactions

Automatically hide the cursor after inactivity

Show click or tap effects during interactions

[h2]Character Expression Parts System[/h2]

Previously, each expression variation required a separate image file.
Now you can use modular character parts to create expressions dynamically.

For example:
With 3 outfits, 5 expressions, and 5 hairstyles — you’d traditionally need 75 images.
With the new system, you only need 13 parts, reducing file size and improving performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/876c7712a01109dc593f83ecdc65bb0f0e9aadd4.png[/img]

This system can also be used for dress-up and still image variations.

[h2]Simple Frame-Based Animation (Eye Blink & Lip Sync)[/h2]

You can now easily animate characters by cycling through prepared image frames.

This works not just for blinking or talking, but for animating any character parts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/e9d3571390d5f59aab20ad58c0f9e2e232a8b1b7.gif[/img]

Lip-syncing can also be triggered automatically during conversations.

[h2]Upcoming: Free English Release of TyranoStudio[/h2]

An English version of "TyranoStudio" — a powerful tool for developing TyranoScript — is coming soon.

It will be released on both Steam and our official website.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/222c4c36a07a78d922b2d0b3b0af0e61441b2bd9.png[/img]

TyranoStudio allows for advanced functionality that may be harder to achieve in TyranoBuilder alone.
You can also use it alongside TyranoBuilder to expand your creative possibilities.

[h2]New English X (Twitter) Account[/h2]

We’ve launched an official English account to share the latest updates and info.
Please feel free to follow us!

https://x.com/tyranovn

notes.title: Announcement of v204 release
notes.notes:
Tyrano Builder has been updated to v204.
The following is an introduction of the newly added features.

Note: This announcement includes changes to v203 and v204.

[h2]Cartoon speech bubble feature[/h2]

Cartoon speech bubbles can now be available in conversational scenes.

It can automatically identify the character who is currently speaking and display a speech bubble.
Detailed customization such as color and shape is also supported.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/d6103382fc3adaf2a98e28d61ba329494bdecf3a.png[/img]

[h2]Added next icon to batch theme conversion[/h2]

Next icons can now be set for each theme in the batch conversion function around UI.

[h2]HTML5 Audio format is now available for audio playback[/h2]

Since Tyrano Builder V2, it has more advanced features such as volume control and seamless looping on smartphones and tablets.

However, there may be a slight lag before playback.
If you want to play BGM and SE without delay, check the following box.

Please note that HTML5 audio has some limitations, such as volume control not working on smartphones and other devices.

[h2]Favorites deck feature[/h2]

Previously, the position of the component in the left area was fixed.
With the newly added favorites deck feature, the placement can be customized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/51233fd92193138a45310b269a57cdc3fe8bdc67.png[/img]

Select the component you want to add to favorites and right-click -> "Add to Favorites".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/eb5fd3c69f87e1c6f627bf41e14db461d6d0680e.png[/img]

You can put any name you like on your favorites.
It will be added to the left area. Then you can use it just like a normal component.
In addition, multiple components can be registered in favorites at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/54ace706ee42cdb788247230f0aa81e00fc64d8d.png[/img]

In this example image, three components were added to the timeline at once by using the favorites component.

[h2]■Managing favorites deck[/h2]

You can delete or hide favorites that you no longer use.
Click on Manage Components in the upper right corner of the screen.

You can rename or delete from favorites management tag.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/42302f9db11bce54361e7f4cbe139dba0cbf5f6b.png[/img]

[h2]New theme "Garden"[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/e776219a9a6241ecf08a133d48c6a02d0f4369cc.png[/img]

Seems to be easy to use with its calm atmosphere.

[h2]Seven themes now available in HD of 1280 × 720 pixels[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/eb0785fa7f413951b9a66597b8ef12dbaf60ead4.png[/img]

[h2]Others[/h2]

Updated embedded Tyranno scripts.
Bug fixes and stability improvements.

notes.title: ★MAJOR★ Update to v2.0! Now available as Beta!
notes.notes:
[i]THANK YOU[/i] to all for your patience! TyranoBuilder v2.0 is now available as a beta version and this will become the main version from August 1st 2021. 

[i][b]PLEASE NOTE!![/b][/i] We are releasing this version initially as a beta due to potential compatibility issues with projects made in v18x. While the front end is mostly unchanged, TyranoBuilder's underlying architecture has been completely overhauled to provide a faster and smoother experience and to add a numerous new features and improvements. Unfortunately, the downside of this upgrade is that projects created in previous versions may run into compatibility issues and fail to run properly when loaded into v2.0.

As such, we do [i]NOT[/i] recommend  loading projects created in previous versions of TyranoBuilder in v2.0. We recommend that any projects that were created in TyranoBuilder v18x are completed in that version. For new projects, please go ahead and start with v2.0!

For anyone who simply [i]must[/i] migrate their project from v18x to v2.0, we have prepared a guide at this page: [url=http://tyranobuilder.com/migrate-from-v18x-to-v2/]http://tyranobuilder.com/migrate-from-v18x-to-v2/[/url]. Please note: we cannot guarantee that this method will work in all cases.

[h3]To update to TyranoBuilder v2.0:[/h3]
In your Steam Library, right click on 'TyranoBuilder Visual Novel Studio', then select Properties > Betas and select v2.0 from the dropdown at the top of the window. TyranoBuilder should then automatically download and install the update. If the update does not automatically start, restarting your Steam client should get it moving.

Please see below for an overview of what’s changed and what’s new.

[h3]★ TyranoScript updated to v5[/h3]
TyranoScript, the scripting language that TyranoBuilder runs upon, is now upgraded to the latest version, v5. V5 changes the architecture from v4 and now runs faster and more stably than ever. From v5, a number of new, advanced features are now available including streaming camera background, QR codes, opening websites, using and manipulating character parts, and using 3D graphics in your projects. For details, see the [url=http://tyranobuilder.com/tyranoscript-tags-reference/]TyranoScript Tags Reference[/url] page.


[h3]★ Chromium engine and JavaScript updated[/h3]
TyranoBuilder’s Chromium engine is updated from v41 to v78 and packaging for PC has been changed from nw.js to Electron. TyranoBuilder now supports the latest JavaScript syntax; drawing functionality and other features are significantly improved.


[h3]★ Live2D compatibility upgraded to v4.0~[/h3]
TyranoBuilder now supports 3D models and animated created in Live2D 4.x.

[previewyoutube=vemkL43ajWc;full]https://youtu.be/vemkL43ajWc[/previewyoutube]

[h3]★ Message text animation [/h3]
12 different types of animation can now be applied to message texts and can be combined within the same text window. 

[previewyoutube=UTGm_DIqGXs;full]https://youtu.be/UTGm_DIqGXs[/previewyoutube]
Text animations are set in [Game Settings]>[Font Style]>[Animation].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/39b284d990e32769dfcd68102797f7556b63ecaa.jpg[/img]


[h3]★ Rounded message boxes [/h3]
The corners of the message box can now be set to rounded and freely sized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/eed490cf6c0dee92a6008f9c71b4fb37b328ace5.jpg[/img]


[h3]★ Range of branch buttons increased[/h3]
Over 240 types of branch buttons are now available. Click on the image below to visit the [url=http://tyranobuilder.com/branch_buttons/]Branch Buttons Reference[/url] page and see the available types.

[url=http://tyranobuilder.com/branch_buttons/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/657250463d8caeadfa03bbf2f409634e50019fdc.jpg[/img][/url]


[h3]★ Global themes localized and new themes [/h3]
Global themes that allow you to set the UI for the entire game are now fully localized into English and two new themes have been added: Sea Foam and Shine.

[b]Sea Foam[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/32ed72be2e4fa9d4e597f8390623e8656c90371a.png[/img]

[b]Shine[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/aef0a1c849c319ed1c8bb7f4ad3a6af2a30d9521.png[/img]

[b]Cherry Blossom[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/739ea848cdec6cc6386bad67a19f92ad84b5d0c4.png[/img]


[h3]★ New developer tools [/h3]
More support and tools are included for advanced developers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/92fb31652ec67452cb28646d2345a08ce352d239.jpg[/img]


[h3]★ Variable watching[/h3]
This new feature enables real-time monitoring of variable values while previewing projects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8194444/edf5769c73ad6e3116915813dcb607cf1d9c84cc.jpg[/img]


[h3]★ Component tracking[/h3]
View which components are running in preview and debug modes.
[previewyoutube=ujnFO0JRPb8;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]★ TyranoScript tracking[/h3]
Track and view the TyranoScript that is executing in the background while previewing in real-time.

[previewyoutube=YkW93fV45e4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]PLUS:[/h1]

[h3]★ Improved exporting for PC games[/h3]
The below settings are now available when exporting projects for PC:
・Select between 64-bit and 32-bit versions
・Customize the application icon
・File hiding (packaging)

[h3]★ Vastly improved startup speed and packaging support for large scale games[/h3]
With previous versions of TyranoBuilder, large scale games sometimes encountered issues when packaging and could take a long time to start up, depending on the environment. From TyranoBuilder v2.0 and later, even large-scale games will start instantly.

[h3]★ Support for mp3 audio files [/h3]
Due to popular demand (and now that we’re certain there are no potential legal problems!), support for mp3 format sound files is reinstated. This is now our recommended audio format as it’s supported by a wide variety of devices and platforms.

[h3]★ mp4 video support [/h3]
mp4 format movies are now supported in the "Movie", "Background Movie", and "Movie Composition" components.

[h3]★ Enhanced audio functionality[/h3]
New music-related features include: seamless music looping, pre-loading of music files, and improved audio volume support for smartphones.

[h3]★ APNG support [/h3]
APNG format animation files are now supported. These allow for higher-definition animations than GIF.

[h3]★ Other updates :[/h3]
Various minor quality of life improvements and new features, such as:
[list][*] Popup windows now allow for minimization and functionality for projects with the same or higher resolution than the screen. 
[*] Improved stability when the 3D camera interacts with other components like Quake. [/list]

Once again, on behalf of Nyu Media and STRIKEWORKS, thank you for your patience while this update was in production. While there may be waits between updates, be assured that both TyranoScript and TyranoBuilder are constantly being improved upon and new builds rolled out to Steam once they have passed their QA period in Japan. We hope you enjoy the upgrade to v2.0! For any feedback, suggestions, or questions, please post a message at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/345370/discussions/]TyranoBuilder Discussion Group[/url]. 

[b][i][h1]HAPPY CREATING!![/h1][/i][/b]

notes.title: Surprise Update v184 Live On Monday!
notes.notes:
Hey, TyranoBuilders!

We have a small update for you coming on Monday which adds support for Live2D Cubism 3.0 models among other improvements. There are some essential things to know about how this update might affect your current projects, so please read below:

[h1]1. Four New Themes Added[/h1]
Here is an example of one of the themes:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8194444/577c64d04b6e4557aa2c5c321371df04b686c65d.png[/img]


[h1]2. New Image Scaling Functionality
[/h1]You can now scale the size of an image in the visual image positioning tool using the scroll wheel of the mouse.

[h1]3. TyranoScript Updated 
[/h1]TyranoScript has been updated to the latest version, which adds some performance improvements and optimization. No new tags have been added this time. 

[h1]4. Live2D Cubism 3.0 Support Added
[/h1]Form v184 you can use model3.json models (which support lip-sync!), BUT [i]previous versions are no longer supported[/i]. Here are two options should you wish to continue to use previous versions:

i) Convert earlier models to v3.0 using the tool at the following link: https://docs.live2d.com/cubism-editor-manual/convert-id/ 
* The page is in Japanese. Please use Google Translate or Chrome to translate if required.  

ii) If you're not ready to update your models, you can always revert to the previous version of TyranoBuilder by following the steps at the below link: https://steamcommunity.com/app/345370/discussions/0/405690850610041992/ 
(All previous versions of TyranoBuilder are available for use, but newer features may not be available in the older versions.)

That's it for this update! If you have any thoughts of feedback, please let us know in the comments!

notes.title: Major Update: Live2D, Ready-to-Use Sample Assets, Cloud-saving, MORE!
notes.notes:
TyranoBuilder just received its first major update which adds numerous new features and fixes, including Live2D. Details are below, but first...

PLEASE NOTE!!
Every effort has been made to ensure that projects made with the previous version of TyranoBuilder will be completely compatible with the updated version, we 100% rule out the possibility of an issue coming up depending on particular projects.

To allow for this, we have taken two steps: 

1) TyranoBuilder will automatically detect projects created in the previous version and offer to create a backup before converting to the new build. Please backup your project just to be safe!

2) The previous version of TyranoBuilder will still be available as a Beta version from your Steam Library. To access the previous version, right-click on TyranoBuilder in your Steam Library, and go to Properties > BETAS and select Previous build from the drop down menu. 
Please revert to this version if you find that your project has incompatibility issues with the current build.

All righty then, here's what is new to TyranoBuilder:

[list]
[*] Live2D functionality *
[*] Cloud saving (up to 1gb)
[*] Online asset library with sample assets (characters, backgrounds, Live2D models  & more to follow in future!)
[*] Character art resizing within positioning tool
[*] Character art mirroring
[*] Scenario file duplication, deletion and renaming
[*] Branch button resizing and positioning by drag and drop 
[*] Spaces can be used in labels (they are converted to underscores)
[*] 'Complete before Proceeding' option added to Join / Exit Scene
[*] Create New Project settings can skipped/agreed to by pressing Enter
[*] Various localization tweaks and fixes
[/list]

* We're particularly excited for the Live2D functionality. This can [i]REALLY[/i] take your visual novels to the next level! Visit the below link check out the Live2D tutorial, preview how it works, what it does, and see some demos:

http://tyranobuilder.com/use-live2d-in-your-games/ 

We’re excited for Live2D of course, but also very happy about other improvements such as character resizing within the positioning tool (phew!), and character mirroring! Sooo satisfying :)

We hope you enjoy the update! There will be more to follow as we continue to improve and refine TyranoBuilder. If you have any feedback or suggestions for new features, please drop a note in the official suggestions thread at the link below:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/345370/discussions/0/611701999536116125/

Also, a quick heads up:  we’re planning a pretty big visual novel development contest which should kick off by the end of this month. It will have a pretty generous development period (likely a couple of months) and some nice prizes, so now might be a good time to work on those TyranoBuilder chops in preparation! ;)

That about covers it for this update. Please leave any comments or feedback in the discussion group.

Thank you!

notes.title: Major Update: Live2D, Ready-to-Use Sample Assets, Cloud-saving, MORE!
notes.notes:
TyranoBuilder just received its first major update which adds numerous new features and fixes, including Live2D. Details are below, but first...

PLEASE NOTE!!
Every effort has been made to ensure that projects made with the previous version of TyranoBuilder will be completely compatible with the updated version, we 100% rule out the possibility of an issue coming up depending on particular projects.

To allow for this, we have taken two steps: 

1) TyranoBuilder will automatically detect projects created in the previous version and offer to create a backup before converting to the new build. Please backup your project just to be safe!

2) The previous version of TyranoBuilder will still be available as a Beta version from your Steam Library. To access the previous version, right-click on TyranoBuilder in your Steam Library, and go to Properties > BETAS and select Previous build from the drop down menu. 
Please revert to this version if you find that your project has incompatibility issues with the current build.

All righty then, here's what is new to TyranoBuilder:

[list]
[*] Live2D functionality *
[*] Cloud saving (up to 1gb)
[*] Online asset library with sample assets (characters, backgrounds, Live2D models  & more to follow in future!)
[*] Character art resizing within positioning tool
[*] Character art mirroring
[*] Scenario file duplication, deletion and renaming
[*] Branch button resizing and positioning by drag and drop 
[*] Spaces can be used in labels (they are converted to underscores)
[*] 'Complete before Proceeding' option added to Join / Exit Scene
[*] Create New Project settings can skipped/agreed to by pressing Enter
[*] Various localization tweaks and fixes
[/list]

* We're particularly excited for the Live2D functionality. This can [i]REALLY[/i] take your visual novels to the next level! Visit the below link check out the Live2D tutorial, preview how it works, what it does, and see some demos:

http://tyranobuilder.com/use-live2d-in-your-games/ 

We’re excited for Live2D of course, but also very happy about other improvements such as character resizing within the positioning tool (phew!), and character mirroring! Sooo satisfying :)

We hope you enjoy the update! There will be more to follow as we continue to improve and refine TyranoBuilder. If you have any feedback or suggestions for new features, please drop a note in the official suggestions thread at the link below:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/345370/discussions/0/611701999536116125/

Also, a quick heads up:  we’re planning a pretty big visual novel development contest which should kick off by the end of this month. It will have a pretty generous development period (likely a couple of months) and some nice prizes, so now might be a good time to work on those TyranoBuilder chops in preparation! ;)

That about covers it for this update. Please leave any comments or feedback in the discussion group.

Thank you!

notes.title: Sneak Peek for our Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
Hello To all the Tyranos!

I hope that you have been having an amazing experence using TyranoBuilder

I know we have been having a great time interacting with everyone on the forums both with hearing your suggestions and assisting with projects which are really showing great promise on all that can be done in TyranoBuilder!

Our next update is going to include live2D support which will allow you to control animated characters that move and react in the scene but just saying this doesn't do it justice so we have a preview for you to check out: 

HoukagoQuest! 2 http://lk.rossa.cc/game/game02_en.html
